spans.s: मण् vi. 1P (pres. मणति) To sound, to murmur.

मणि m.f. 1. A jewel, a gem, यदि मणिस्त्रपुणि प्रणिधीयते Panch.i., R.i.4, iii.18, Megh.ii.1, Bg.vii.7; 2. ornament in general; 3. a loadstone, a magnet; 4. the wrist; 5. a water-pot; 6. penis; 7. clitoris; 8. anything excellent of its kind. (The word is also written मणी in the feminine.)
मणि-इंद्र, -राज m. a diamond.
मणि-इंद्र, -राज m. a diamond.
मणि-कण्ठ m. the blue jay.
मणि-कण्ठक m. a cock.
मणि-कर्णिका, -कर्णी f. the name of a sacred pool in Benares.
मणि-कर्णिका, -कर्णी f. the name of a sacred pool in Benares.
मणि-काच m. the feathered part of an arrow.
मणि-कानन n. the neck.
मणि-कार m. a jeweller.
मणि-तारक m. the Sārasa bird.
मणि-दर्पण m. a mirror adorned with jewels.
मणि-द्वीप m. 1. the hood of the serpent Ananta; 2. name of an island in the ocean of nectar.
मणि-धनु m. a rainbow.
मणि-धनुस् n. a rainbow.
मणि-पाली f. a female keeper of jewels.
मणि-पुष्पक m. name of the conch shell of Sahadeva, Bg.i.16.
मणि-पूर (I) m. 1. the navel; 2. a kind of bodice.
मणि-पूर (II) n. name of a town in Kalinga.
मणि-प्रत्युप्त a. set with jewels.
मणि-बंध m. the wrist.
माणिबंध n. Rock-salt.
मणि-बंधन n. 1. an ornament of pearls; 2. that part of a ring where the jewels are set; 3. the wrist.
मणि-बीज, -वीज m. the pomegranate tree.
मणि-बीज, -वीज m. the pomegranate tree.
मणि-भित्ति f. name of the palace of Śeṣa.
मणि-भू f. a floor inlaid with jewels.
मणि-भूमि f. 1. a mine of jewels; 2. a floor inlaid with jewels.
मणि-मत् m. 1. the sun; 2. name of a place of pilgrimage.
मणि-मन्थ n. rock-salt.
माणिबंध n. Rock-salt.
मणि-माला f. 1. a necklace of jewels; 2. lustre, beauty; 3. an epithet of Lakshml; 4. the circular impression of a bite (in amorous sports).
मणि-यष्टि f. a jewelled stick.
मणि-रत्न n. a jewel, a gem.
मणि-राग (I) m. the colour of jewels.
मणि-राग (II) n. vermilion.
मणि-शिला f. a jewelled slab.
मणि-सर m. a necklace.
मणि-सूत्र n. a string of pearls.
मणि-सोपान n. a jewelled staircase.
मणि-स्तंभ m. a pillar set with jewels.
मणि-हर्म्य n. a jewelled palace.
मणिक (I) m.n. A pitcher.
मणिक (II) m. A jewel.
माणिका f. A particular weight equal to eight palas.
मणित n. A murmuring sound uttered at cohabitation. (Also भणित.)
मणीचक (I) n. The moon-stone.
मणीचक (II) m. A halcyon.
मणीवक n. A flower.
मण्ठ m. A kind of sweetmeat.
मण्ड (I) m.n. 1. The scum which forms on the surface of any liquid; 2. the scum of boiled rice, नीवारौदनमंडमुष्णमधुरम् Ut.iv.; 3. cream; 4. gruel; 5. pith, essence; 6. the head.
मण्ड (II) m. 1. Ornament; 2. a castor-oil plant; 3. a frog.
मण्डा f. 1. Spirituous liquor; 2. the myrobalan tree.
मण्ड-उदक n. 1. decoration of walls &c. on festive occasions; 2. mental excitement.
मण्ड-प m.n. 1. an open hall; 2. a tent, a pavilion, R.v.73; 3. a building consecrated to a deity; 4. a bower, Megh.ii.15.
मण्ड-प˚प्रतिष्ठा f. the consecration of a temple.
मण्ड-हारक m. a distiller of spirits.
मण्डक m. A kind of baked flour.
मण्डन (I) n. 1. The act of decorating or adorning, मामक्षमं मण्डनकालहानेर्वेत्तवि बिम्बाधरबद्धतृष्णम् R.xiii.16, प्रत्यादिष्टविशेषमण्डनविधिः Sak.vi.; 2. ornament, embellishment, R.viii.71, xxx.30.
मण्डन (II) m. Name of a philosopher, a contemporary and opponent of Śankara.
मण्डन-मिश्र m. the same as मण्डन II q.v., e.g. अवेहि तन्मण्डनमिश्रधाम.
मण्डयन्त m. 1. An ornament; 2. an actor; 3. food; 4. an assembly of women.
मण्डयन्ती f. A woman.
मण्डरी f. A kind of cricket.
मण्डल (I) m. 1. A dog; 2. a kind of snake; 3. an army arrayed in a circle.

मण्डल (II) n. 1. Anything round or circular, वपुर्महोरगस्येव करालफणमंडलम् R.xii.98, सहारयष्टिस्तनमंडलार्पणैः Rt.i.8, Sis.ix.66, K.S.i.24; 2. a disk, especially the disk of the sun or moon, दिनमणिमण्डलमण्डन Git.G.i.; 3. a circle, a globe, a circumference, a ring, असह्यवातोद्गतरेणुमण्डला प्रचंडसूर्यातपतापिता मही Rt.i.10, छायामण्डललक्ष्येण तमदृश्या किल स्वयम् R.iv.5; 4. the orbit of a heavenly body; 5. the visible horizon; 6. a halo round the sun or moon; 7. a district, a territory, a province (as in चोलमण्डल); 8. a particular position of the feet in shooting; 9. a kind of mystical diagram used in summoning a divinity; 10. a multitude, an assemblage, a collection, a group, a company, तेन सिंहासनं पित्र्यमखिलं चारिमण्डलम् R.iv.4, हसति स्वैरं सखीमण्डले Git.G.viii.; 11. a sort of leprosy with circular spots; 12. a sort of perfume; 13. the circle of a king’s near and distant neighbours (in politics); [such neighbouring princes are enumerated to be eight, twelve or sixteen; See Yaj.i.345, and Vijnyāneśvara’s gloss on it; Rāghavānanda on M.vii.158 defines the circle to consist of three kings on each of the four frontiers of the kingdom; the immediate neighbours are the enemies (अरि), and their neighbours the friends (मित्र) of the central king, while the kings next to them are neutral (उदासीन)]; 14. a division of the Ṛgveda; (the whole sanhita of the Ṛgveda is divided into ten maṇḍalas).
मण्डल-अग्र m. a bent sword, a scimitar.
मण्डल-अधिप, -अधीश, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. the governor of a province; 2. a king, an emperor.
मण्डल-अधिप, -अधीश, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. the governor of a province; 2. a king, an emperor.
मण्डल-अधिप, -अधीश, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. the governor of a province; 2. a king, an emperor.
मण्डल-अधिप, -अधीश, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. the governor of a province; 2. a king, an emperor.
मण्डल-कार्मुक a. having a circular bow.
मण्डल-नृत्य n. a circular dance.
मण्डल-न्यास m. the drawing of a circle.
मण्डल-पुच्छक m. a kind of insect.
मण्डल-वट m. a fig tree forming a circle.
मण्डल-वर्तिन् m. the ruler of a small kingdom.
मण्डल-वर्ष n. general rain extending over a whole district.
मण्डल-शस् ind. 1. in groups, in multitudes; 2. in circles.
मण्डलक n. 1. A circle; 2. a disk; 3. white leprosy with round spots; 4. a group, a company; 5. a mirror, a looking-glass.
मण्डलायित n. A globe, a ball.
मण्डलित a. (f. ता) Rounded, made round.
मण्डलित a. (f. ता) Rounded, made round.
मण्डलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Forming a circle; 2. ruling a country.
मण्डलिन् (II) m. 1. A snake in general; 2. a kind of snake (गोनास); 3. a cat; 4. a dog; 5. the Indian fig tree; 6. the ruler of a district; 7. the sun.
मण्डलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Forming a circle; 2. ruling a country.
मण्डित a. (f. ता) Adorned, ornamented.
मण्डित a. (f. ता) Adorned, ornamented.
मण्डूक (I) m. 1. A frog, फणी न हन्ति मण्डूककुलं तृषाकुलः Rt.i.20.
मण्डूक (II) n. A kind of coitus.
मण्डूक-अनुवृत्ति, -प्लुति f. (a frog-leap) skipping over any portion or omitting it.
मण्डूक-अनुवृत्ति, -प्लुति f. (a frog-leap) skipping over any portion or omitting it.
मण्डूक-कुल n. an assemblage of frogs.
मण्डूक-योग m. a kind of meditation in which the meditator sits motionless like a frog.
मण्डूक-सरस् n. a pond full of frogs.
मण्डूकी f. 1. A female frog; 2. a wanton woman.
मण्डूर n. Rust of iron used as a medicine.
माणव m. 1. A boy, a lad, a youngster (used contemptuously), e.g. भिक्षामाणव; 2. a pearl-necklace of sixteen or twenty strings.
माणवक m. 1. A youngster, a lad, a boy (used contemptuously); 2. a dwarf, a little man, e.g. मायामाणवको हरिः; 3. a religious student; 4. a pearl-necklace of sixteen or twenty strings.
माणवीन a. (f. ना) Boyish, childish.
माणवीन a. (f. ना) Boyish, childish.
माणव्य n. A company of lads.
माणिक्य n. A ruby.
माणिक्या f. A house-lizard.
